question: What is the relative difference in percentage points of saving note redemption rate out of the average amount outstanding for the 1980 and 1981 calendar years, rounded to the nearest hundredth places?
raw_response:
From Table SN-1 (calendar years):
1980: redemptions = 71, amount outstanding = 300; prior year outstanding = 352
1981: redemptions = 51, amount outstanding = 269; prior year outstanding = 300

Using average amount outstanding:
1980 rate = 71 / ((352 + 300) / 2) × 100 = 21.78
1981 rate = 51 / ((300 + 269) / 2) × 100 = 17.93

Difference = 3.85 percentage points

<FINAL_ANSWER>3.85</FINAL_ANSWER>
